list.name: company_id
list.query: SELECT id::text AS __value, name AS __text FROM companies ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(cost_cents)::float/100 FROM cost_events WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW())
SELECT count(*) FROM agents WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND status != 'paused'
SELECT count(*) FROM document_intake WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT count(*) FROM approvals WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND status = 'pending'

SELECT a.name AS agent, SUM(ce.cost_cents)::float/100 AS dollars FROM cost_events ce LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = ce.agent_id WHERE ce.company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND ce.occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY dollars DESC

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, model, SUM(cost_cents)::float/100 AS value FROM cost_events WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at, actor_type, action, entity_type FROM activity_log WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT id, source_type, doc_type, status, created_at FROM document_intake WHERE company_id = '${company_id}'::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 25
